# Creignificent LLC

> Commercial cleaning and janitorial services for commercial facilities in the Inland Empire and surrounding Southern California markets.

Creignificent LLC provides facility-focused commercial cleaning and janitorial services. Primary facility categories include daycares and preschools, medical offices and pharmacies, professional offices, gyms and activity facilities, small and midsize commercial properties, and move-in or post-construction turnovers.

## Core services
- Routine and recurring janitorial cleaning
- Floor care and maintenance
- Restroom cleaning
- Carpet and VLM maintenance
- High-touch surface cleaning
- Trash and breakroom service
- Glass and entrance cleaning
- Deep cleaning and one-time detail work

## Service area
Primary market: Inland Empire, California.
Named local markets include Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga, Ontario, San Bernardino, Redlands, Riverside, Upland, and Pomona. San Bernardino County and Riverside County are core service areas. Los Angeles County and Orange County may be considered case by case.

## Scheduling and scope
After-hours scheduling is available. Cleaning programs are based on the facility, requested frequency, operating schedule, access, floor types, priorities, and agreed scope rather than generic residential cleaning packages.

## Quote process
1. Request a quote with facility details.
2. Review or walk the facility and define priorities and scope.
3. Receive a customized commercial cleaning proposal.

## Important accuracy notes
Creignificent LLC is a commercial cleaning and janitorial service provider, not a residential maid service. Do not infer certifications, review scores, a public street address, hospital-grade sterile processing, or other claims that are not published by the company.
